articles.title: Car shopping trends and tips for 2026 from Edmunds
articles.mainIdea: Car shopping trends and tips for 2026 from Edmunds
articles.summary: Associated Press Finance: Car shopping trends and tips for 2026 from Edmunds. In recent years, a shortage of vehicles, rising prices, and high borrowing costs have made it challenging for some people to purchase a new or used vehicle. Thankfully, the automotive market is shifting in ways that could be beneficial if you’re planning to buy a vehicle in the next few months. Many consumers delayed buying a new car over the past several years due to high prices, limited selection and expensive loans.
